name: tco-m3-d0-d1inventory01
argv:
import sys,time,traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import run_profiled_d0 as common
import profiled_d1_artifacts as artifacts
runtime=common.runtime_identity()
checks=common.read(common.ROOT/'results/lora_profiled_d1_v1/preparation01.json')
assert checks['pass_all'] and checks['tests_run']==84
before={name:common.sha(common.ROOT/name,text=True) for name in checks['source_sha256_lf']}
assert before==checks['source_sha256_lf']
output=common.ROOT/'results/lora_profiled_d1_v1'
common.write_new(output/'inventory_checks01.started.json',dict(schema='profiled_d1_inventory_preparation_started_v1',started_at_utc=common.now(),source_sha256_lf=before,arrays_deserialized=False))
start=time.monotonic()
try:
    inventory=artifacts.build_inventory(common.ROOT,'manifests/lora_profiled_d1_design_v1.json',Path('/weights'))
    after={name:common.sha(common.ROOT/name,text=True) for name in before}
    assert before==after
    common.write_new(output/'inputs_preparation01.json',inventory)
    report=dict(schema='profiled_d1_inventory_preparation_checks_v1',pass_all=True,source_sha256_lf=before,runtime=runtime,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,inventory=dict(file='results/lora_profiled_d1_v1/inputs_preparation01.json',sha256=common.sha(output/'inputs_preparation01.json')),arrays_deserialized=False,model_forward_calls=0,optimizer_updates=0,rental_usd=0,execution_ready=False,full_parent_seal_replayed=False,scope='Selected actual input byte hashes and JSON provenance; no production tensor decode or launch authorization')
    common.write_new(output/'inventory_checks01.json',report)
    print('Selected D1 byte inventory passed without tensor decoding',flush=True)
except BaseException as exc:
    common.write_new(output/'inventory_checks01.failure.json',dict(schema='profiled_d1_inventory_preparation_failure_v1',pass_all=False,error_type=type(exc).__name__,message=str(exc),traceback=traceback.format_exc(),arrays_deserialized=False,model_forward_calls=0))
    raise
